hub_desc_backend: Configure local and cloud AI providers (Ollama, Llama.cpp, KoboldCpp, OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini) and active models.
hub_desc_keymanager: Manage encrypted API keys, cloud credentials, and multi-key rotation profiles securely.
hub_desc_persona: Choose, customize, and author AI personalities (Souls), tone rules, and behavioral prompts.
hub_desc_filters: Define text sanitization rules, output cleanup filters, and response post-processing.
hub_desc_memory: Configure local RAG semantic memory vaults, embeddings, context recall, and retention limits.
hub_desc_agent: Tune the autonomous agent loop, iteration limits, tool execution safety, and trace persistence.
hub_desc_vision: Configure multimodal image perception, visual input models, OCR, and screen/image analysis.
hub_desc_voice: Configure local neural TTS engines (Fish Speech, Kokoro, Piper, XTTS), microphones, VAD, and audio routing.
hub_desc_payload: Control what context, system prompts, memory, and tool schemas are injected into each LLM payload.
hub_desc_sysnet: Configure WebUI server host, ports, HTTPS/PKI certificates, LAN access, and proxy settings.
hub_desc_executor: Configure system command execution rules, shell permissions, sandboxing, and safety policies.
hub_desc_action_plans: Manage Multimodal Action Plans: inspect saved blueprints, history, exports, and planner presets.
hub_desc_hdcs: Browse and configure Direct Commands (/) for zero-latency native actions bypassing the AI.
hub_desc_shortcuts: View and customize global and WebUI keyboard shortcuts for rapid navigation and controls.
hub_desc_help: Access documentation, Hecos version details, diagnostics, and project resources.
hub_desc_users: Manage user accounts, roles, permissions, and isolated per-user memory vaults (Admin).
hub_desc_system: Configure global core preferences: language, startup options, external dependencies, and maintenance.
hub_desc_logs: Inspect real-time server logs, filter by subsystem or severity, and troubleshoot issues live.
hub_desc_privacy: Configure 3-tier privacy modes (Normal, Auto-Wipe, Incognito), history retention, and data cleanup.
hub_desc_hpm_settings: Configure Module Manager repositories, Store sources, restart policies, and package diagnostics.
hub_desc_presenter: Configure the live Presenter engine for real-time voice commentary, announcements, and Playbook guidance.
hub_desc_chat_ui: Customize the Chat workspace layout, message display, sidebar behavior, and visual preferences.
